title: AI vs Software
summary: Fixed software for calculations — flexible AI for language; often both are needed.

sections.heading: Orientation — What Will You Understand?
sections.subtitle: What Will You Understand?
sections.contentMarkdown:
- What Will You Understand? Not every task requires AI — traditional software is not weaker, just different.
- Why Now? In the previous lesson, you learned when to trust AI and when to verify. Today, you will learn when to choose AI in the first place.
- What After the Lesson? You will choose the right tool for 3 tasks in your life — AI, or Software, or both.

sections.heading: Tension — A Familiar Situation
sections.subtitle: A Familiar Situation
sections.contentMarkdown: Do you use AI for everything — and get surprised when the result is strange? A calculator computes 2+2 = 4 every time. Excel sums the same numbers with the same result. This is Software with fixed rules. AI writes and thinks in language — the response may vary slightly each time based on your question. When you confuse the two, you ask in the wrong place and think that 'AI doesn't work.' The solution: choose the right tool for the task.

sections.heading: Core Idea — The Fundamental Concept
sections.subtitle: The Fundamental Concept
sections.contentMarkdown:
Fixed Software for Calculations — Flexible AI for Language - Fixed Software: Calculator, Excel, CRM, calendar, billing system — the same input gives the same result. Great when the process is clear and repetitive.
- Flexible AI: Helps you with writing, summarizing, thinking, comparing, explaining — great when the task requires language, judgment, or variation.
- The best outcome often comes from both: Excel calculates numbers, and AI writes a simple summary for management. The calendar saves appointments, and AI drafts a reminder message.
- You don’t need to understand programming. Ask: does the task require fixed accuracy or language and thinking?

sections.heading: Glossary — A Simple Difference
sections.subtitle: A Simple Difference
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Term | Meaning | Example |
|---------|--------|------|
| Software | A tool with fixed rules — the same input gives the same result | Excel sums numbers. The calendar saves the appointment |
| AI (Artificial Intelligence) | A language assistant — understands your question and provides a context-appropriate response | Writes 3 versions of an email or summarizes your notes |
